tips.text: Farm Xaku in the same Tier 5 Cambion Drift runs; both blueprints drop from those stages.
Skip boosters for the blueprint; bounty rewards are not in-mission pickups.
Expect duplicate blueprints; clearing every bonus objective can roll Quassus twice.
Rank Entrati, mine and fish while you wait on the blueprint, and save the Scintillant for last.
Players joke about the blueprint; most get it in one to three Tier 5 runs.
Scintillant is the real cost, easy only once you know the Arcana vault loop.
